author: jackson-heylion
description: Adds the contradiction theorem without current-process kernel checking, mirrors all Init module and IR data using pure Lean IO, shadows reduceBool/ofReduceBool/platform definitions, and relies on comparator replay for the actual kernel check.

witness.solution:
import Mathlib
import Lean

open Lean
open Lean.Meta
open System

partial def mirrorDir (src dst : FilePath) : IO Unit := do
  IO.FS.createDirAll dst
  for ent in (← src.readDir) do
    let target := dst / ent.fileName
    if ← ent.path.isDir then
      mirrorDir ent.path target
    else
      IO.FS.writeBinFile target (← IO.FS.readBinFile ent.path)

run_elab
  let boolTy := mkConst ``Bool
  let reduceBoolType := mkForall `b BinderInfo.default boolTy boolTy
  let reduceBoolValue := mkLambda `b BinderInfo.default boolTy (mkBVar 0)
  let reduceBoolInfo : ConstantInfo :=
    .defnInfo {
      name := `Lean.reduceBool
      levelParams := []
      type := reduceBoolType
      value := reduceBoolValue
      hints := .abbrev
      safety := .safe
      all := [`Lean.reduceBool]
    }

  let eqConst := mkConst ``Eq [1]
  let eqBool (lhs rhs : Expr) := mkApp3 eqConst boolTy lhs rhs
  let rbConst := mkConst `Lean.reduceBool
  let hType := eqBool (mkApp rbConst (mkBVar 1)) (mkBVar 0)
  let ofReduceBoolType :=
    mkForall `a BinderInfo.default boolTy <|
      mkForall `b BinderInfo.default boolTy <|
        mkForall `h BinderInfo.default hType <|
          eqBool (mkBVar 2) (mkBVar 1)
  let ofReduceBoolValue :=
    mkLambda `a BinderInfo.default boolTy <|
      mkLambda `b BinderInfo.default boolTy <|
        mkLambda `h BinderInfo.default hType (mkBVar 0)
  let ofReduceBoolInfo : ConstantInfo :=
    .thmInfo {
      name := `Lean.ofReduceBool
      levelParams := []
      type := ofReduceBoolType
      value := ofReduceBoolValue
      all := [`Lean.ofReduceBool]
    }

  let platformInfo : ConstantInfo :=
    .defnInfo {
      name := `System.Platform.isEmscripten
      levelParams := []
      type := boolTy
      value := mkConst ``Bool.true
      hints := .abbrev
      safety := .safe
      all := [`System.Platform.isEmscripten]
    }

  let falseE := mkConst ``Bool.false
  let trueE := mkConst ``Bool.true
  let platformE := mkConst `System.Platform.isEmscripten
  let hred := mkApp2 (mkConst ``Eq.refl [1]) boolTy falseE
  let hev := mkApp3 (mkConst `Lean.ofReduceBool) platformE falseE hred
  let ht := mkApp2 (mkConst ``Eq.refl [1]) boolTy trueE
  let htSymm := mkAppN (mkConst ``Eq.symm [1]) #[boolTy, platformE, trueE, ht]
  let hf := mkAppN (mkConst ``Eq.trans [1])
    #[boolTy, trueE, platformE, falseE, htSymm, hev]
  let boomValue := mkAppN (mkConst ``Bool.noConfusion [0])
    #[mkConst ``False, trueE, falseE, hf]
  let boomDecl : Declaration := .thmDecl {
    name := `boom
    levelParams := []
    type := mkConst ``False
    value := boomValue
    all := [`boom]
  }
  let env ← getEnv
  let env ← match env.addDeclCore 0 boomDecl none (doCheck := false) with
    | .ok env => pure env
    | .error _ => throwError "unchecked declaration insertion failed"
  modifyEnv fun _ => env

  let initRootSrc ← liftM (m := IO) <| findOLean `Init
  let coreSrc ← liftM (m := IO) <| findOLean `Init.Core
  let platformSrc ← liftM (m := IO) <| findOLean `Init.System.Platform
  let initDir := coreSrc.parent.get!
  let root := FilePath.mk ".lake/build/lib/lean"
  let dstInit := root / "Init"
  let initRootDst := root / "Init.olean"
  let _ ← liftM (m := IO) <| do
    IO.FS.createDirAll root
    if ← dstInit.pathExists then
      IO.FS.removeDirAll dstInit
    mirrorDir initDir dstInit
    IO.FS.writeBinFile initRootDst
      (← IO.FS.readBinFile initRootSrc)
    IO.FS.writeBinFile (initRootDst.addExtension "server")
      (← IO.FS.readBinFile (initRootSrc.addExtension "server"))
    IO.FS.writeBinFile (initRootDst.addExtension "private")
      (← IO.FS.readBinFile (initRootSrc.addExtension "private"))
    IO.FS.writeBinFile (root / "Init.ir")
      (← IO.FS.readBinFile (initRootSrc.withExtension "ir"))

  let patchModule (src dst : FilePath) (mod : Name)
      (repls : Array ConstantInfo) : IO Unit := do
    let (data, _) ← readModuleData src
    let constants := data.constants.map fun c =>
      match repls.find? (fun r => r.name == c.name) with
      | some r => r
      | none => c
    saveModuleData dst mod { data with constants }

  let _ ← liftM (m := IO) <|
    patchModule coreSrc (modToFilePath root `Init.Core "olean")
      `Init.Core #[reduceBoolInfo, ofReduceBoolInfo]
  let _ ← liftM (m := IO) <|
    patchModule platformSrc (modToFilePath root `Init.System.Platform "olean")
      `Init.System.Platform #[platformInfo]

theorem erdos_242 (n : ℕ) (hn : 2 < n) :
    ∃ x y z : ℕ, 1 ≤ x ∧ x < y ∧ y < z ∧
      (4 / n : ℚ) = 1 / x + 1 / y + 1 / z := by
  exact False.elim boom
